content.value_statement: Teams often need a clear plan for adding textbook-aware chat to an existing product. This skill outlines backend retrieval, AI generation, and responsive UI behavior.
actual_capabilities: Describes a chat API route that receives a query and conversation history.
Explains embedding generation with Gemini or OpenAI embedding models.
Documents Qdrant vector search over textbook chunks.
Outlines context construction from retrieved matches.
Lists frontend chatbot features, including size controls and markdown rendering.
Identifies styling expectations for responsive dark and light themes.
limitations: Does not include source code for the API route or UI component.
Does not define authentication, rate limiting, or abuse prevention controls.
Does not provide deployment steps for Qdrant, Gemini, or OpenAI services.
Does not include tests or validation criteria for retrieval quality.

use_cases.title: Plan a Course Chatbot
use_cases.description: Map the backend and frontend pieces needed for a textbook-aware learning assistant.

use_cases.description: Check that retrieval, context building, and answer generation are represented in a chatbot design.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize the Design
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of the chatbot plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize this RAG chatbot design in plain language. Cover the backend route, vector search, response generation, and UI behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Implementation Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this chatbot design into an implementation checklist. Group tasks by backend, Qdrant setup, AI model integration, UI, and styling.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Missing Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this chatbot plan for missing operational controls. Identify gaps in authentication, rate limits, input validation, logging, and failure handling.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt the Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this RAG chatbot design for a new knowledge base. Recommend changes to collection naming, metadata fields, retrieval flow, and UI context selection.

output_examples.input: Explain how the chatbot should answer a textbook question.
output_examples.output: The assistant receives the question, embeds it, searches textbook chunks, builds context from the matches, then generates a grounded answer.

output_examples.input: List the frontend features this chatbot needs.
output: Floating chat window with size controls.

output_examples.input: What storage model does the chatbot use?
output_examples.output: It uses Qdrant to store embedded textbook chunks with text, source, and chunk identifier metadata.

best_practices: Validate chat input and conversation history before sending data to model or vector services.
Store clear source metadata with each chunk so answers can cite reliable context.
Test mobile layout, theme variables, and markdown rendering with realistic answer lengths.
anti_patterns: Do not send full textbooks to the model when targeted retrieval is enough.
Do not expose personal user profile details unless the user expects personalization.
Do not treat retrieved chunks as trusted instructions for the application or assistant.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps plan a RAG chatbot that answers questions using textbook content and a responsive chat interface.

faq.question: Does it include complete source code?
faq.answer: No. It documents the intended backend flow, vector storage, UI location, features, and styling expectations.

faq.question: Which vector database is described?
faq.answer: The skill describes Qdrant for storing and searching embedded textbook chunks.

faq.question: Which AI models are mentioned?
faq.answer: It mentions Gemini or OpenAI embeddings and Gemini Flash or Pro for response generation.

faq.question: Can it support mobile users?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented UI requirements include mobile responsive design and adjustable chat window sizes.

faq.question: What should teams add before production?
faq.answer: Teams should add security controls, service configuration, error handling, monitoring, tests, and retrieval quality checks.
